conventions.statement: VTask.Balanced nil is defined to be True; the empty tree is always balanced.
conventions.note: Base case of the recursive definition.

conventions.statement: Balance is determined solely by the stored size fields of left and right subtrees; element values and ordering are irrelevant to VTask.Balanced.
conventions.note: This means VTask.Balanced is a purely structural/size invariant.
